engine.document_parser: Markdown default parser with the same merged dictionary supplied to the linter

state.materialization: JSON file separate from the archive, defaulting beside the resolved archive; GEL_HARPER_DICTIONARY overrides

dto.span_rule: Rust exposes character (Unicode code-point) offsets span_start (inclusive) and span_end (exclusive) per finding. React uses them only for inline highlight rendering; it never interprets them to construct replacements.
dto.suggestion_rule: Rust computes the complete replacement field text and a human-readable suggestion label; React applies suggestions by emitting the replacement text as the next typed-edit value and never constructs replacements itself.
dto.rule_field_rule: Rust exposes the stable Harper rule name per finding. React uses it only for the session-only Disable-rule action; it never maps rule names to fixes.
dto.source_snapshot: Every result carries the exact source text used for checking

legacy_inputs: object with words array and absent schema_version
dictionary.future_schema: fail closed; never downgrade or rewrite a future schema
dictionary.normalization: trim, reject whitespace/control characters, case-insensitive deduplicate, deterministic ordering
dictionary.mutation: add/remove/list through Tauri only; add/remove serialized by writer_operation lock
dictionary.atomic_write: temporary file + fsync + backup promotion; backup cleanup is best effort after successful canonical installation
dictionary.recovery: valid backup may serve as the recovery source for an interrupted/corrupt current file; canonical replacement is performed only by a subsequent successful mutation, while future schema never falls back to an older backup
dictionary.privacy: must not contain credentials, cookies/session state, student identifiers or tutorial text wholesale

ui.checking: debounced 350ms and stale-result-safe by request id plus exact source snapshot
ui.highlighting: teacher_comments and additional_comments render inline wavy-underline highlights via a transparent mirror div overlaid on a native textarea; aims remains a side-panel-only assistant
ui.active_highlight_coupling: hovering or focusing a side-panel lint card strengthens the matching inline mark
ui.acceptance: accepted suggestions emit the existing typed TutorialDraftEdit variants only
ui.add_to_dictionary_gate: single-token excerpts only; multi-word or punctuation-bearing excerpts silently exclude the action
ui.dictionary: explicit local dictionary panel uses only Tauri add/remove/list commands and reports mutations through an onMutation callback so the App can bump a revision counter and trigger re-lint
ui.session_suppression: disabled rules and ignored findings are session-only state hoisted to App; never persisted

forbidden_authority: teacher attribution or tutorial identity mutation
React-side construction of replacement text from span offsets
failure_semantics: Harper check failure is a non-authoritative UI error and never mutates the draft.
A rejected typed edit remains subject to rust_semantic_form validation.
Dictionary mutation failure leaves the prior canonical dictionary bytes authoritative.
Interrupted replacement is recoverable from a valid backup; failed promotion restores the previous canonical file.
Disabled-rule or skip-issue state is ephemeral and never mutates the persisted dictionary or the draft.

acceptance.immutable_evidence: external to source root; generated only by release_gate after exact source/lock/toolchain validation
